name: x402 Testnet Integration with Radius Facilitator
query: Set up x402 payment gating on Radius Testnet for my Hono API. I have a fresh buyer wallet that only holds SBC.
context: The target is unambiguously Radius Testnet. The Radius Testnet facilitator advertises EIP-2612 gas sponsoring, and radius-sdk handles the Permit2 flow.
expected_behavior: Sets network to testnet rather than relying on the mainnet default
Uses a Testnet recipient address supplied for this deployment
Tests the unpaid route for 402 and PAYMENT-REQUIRED
Pays with createRadiusFetch or radius-cli wallet x402 using RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet
Sets a display-unit maxPerRequest or --x402-threshold hard cap
Explains that the Radius facilitator can sponsor the one-time Permit2 approval so the payer needs only SBC
Checks the PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt and settlement on Testnet
success_criteria: No Mainnet facilitator, chain ID, recipient, or wallet assumption is substituted for Testnet
The official SDK middleware is used instead of a hand-written protocol module
The buyer cap is explicit and is not presented as a cumulative budget
The answer does not require native RUSD for the sponsored first payment
Any live validation claim is made only when the commands were actually run
